runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 18:49 sweep across 12 source families: Profesia, direct company careers/public ATS, LinkedIn public jobs indexing, Worki, Kariera/Zoznam, Brigada.sk, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and publicly indexed Facebook groups. Fresh Upwork discovery produced several WooCommerce/e-commerce jobs but none passed the economic/scope threshold for LIVE promotion: $30 fixed marketplace operations is expert-scoped, $100 WordPress maintenance already has 20-50 proposals and interviews, $10 WordPress management already has a hire, and hard-development roles exceed the current profile. Wolt Bratislava remains explicit B2 English. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Source-query yield decay tracker
developmentChanges.reason: Track repeated zero-yield query patterns per source family and rotate wording/category combinations after several unproductive runs. This reduces repeated hourly searching that returns the same stale set while preserving truthful coverage.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance client-friction score
developmentChanges.reason: Rank remote freelance jobs using client history, active hires, proposal saturation, interview count and fixed-price scope together. This prevents keyword-perfect WooCommerce jobs with poor practical win probability from crowding stronger opportunities.
